findings.section: Approach > computeReviewKindSummary algorithm; Acceptance Criteria AC7/AC8
findings.description: The plan weighted `counts`/`totalEntries` by collapsedCount but defined `actionableCount = candidates.length` / `needsActionCount = candidates.filter(...).length` without stating whether those are collapsedCount-weighted or display-row counts. With collapse enabled, 3 identical `done` rows collapse to 1 display row: `counts.done === 3` but `actionableCount === 1` — an undocumented inconsistency an implementer could resolve either way.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: explicitly defined `actionableCount`/`needsActionCount`/`shownRows`/`actionable[].length` as DISPLAY-ROW counts (required for the cap-on-array-length + truncatedActionable logic to be coherent), while `counts`/`totalEntries` stay collapsedCount-weighted ORIGINAL totals; each `actionable[]` row carries `collapsedCount` so per-row multiplicity is recoverable. Added the headline clarification (per-kind from counts, actionable=/needsAction= from display-row counts), a new AC7b, and a dedicated collapsed-actionable test requirement (counts.done===3, actionableCount===1, actionable[0].collapsedCount===3).
